item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct 2024 evidence that Kishida staffed nuclear/security decisions with loyalists or ideological hardliners, or bypassed expert institutions in favor of personal loyalty. The available record points to NRA screening, NPT/FMCT diplomacy, and cabinet/institutional channels. The safest conclusion is that Kishida leaned on institutions and expert frameworks in 2024; evidence for loyalist/ideologue capture is weak or absent.","evidence":[{"title":"Press Conference by the Prime Minister on His Visit to Ishikawa Prefecture to Confirm the Extent of the Damage Caused by the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake and Other Matters","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"January 14, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/14kaiken.html","summary":"Kishida said the Nuclear Regulation Authority found no safety issues at the Shika Nuclear Power Station after the earthquake and emphasized that any restart would still require rigorous screening under post-Fukushima regulatory standards.
